The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core weighted-risk assessment implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.86 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.34s. While the logic is functional, future iterations should verify edge cases in weight distribution to ensure the 0.14 judge reward gap isn't due to missing boundary condition handling.
